description: Scope-leakage thresholds per .claude/rules/scope-control.md. Consumer: git-auditor's checklist and (mechanically) policy-engine.mjs's scopeCheck(), which git-auditor's evidence review is expected to run before verdict.
note: 0 unexplained files means every dirty/untracked file must be traceable to a RequirementRecord, a disposed Finding, or an open ChangeSet — not that a mission may never touch more than zero files.
